subject.title: Hosted Molty (usemolty.com): model selector doesn't persist — API always receives dotted id claude-opus-4.8[Błąd]:

question: Should this be handled first as a hosted Molty deployment/state repair, or is there still a reachable OpenClaw source path where Brain & Keys can send label-derived dotted Anthropic ids or ignore provider selection?
rationale: Current main’s normal UI and gateway paths use catalog ids and session model patches, but the hosted screenshots/comments show deployed behavior that blocks replies and may be outside this repository’s source path.

options.title: Inspect hosted payload and state
options.body: Have the hosted Molty owner capture the Brain & Keys save/session patch payload, stored workspace selection, and outgoing provider/model request, then repair deployment or migrate stale state if needed.

options.title: Open a focused source regression
options.body: If hosted Molty uses this exact source path, add a narrow UI/gateway regression that prevents provider selection from being ignored and rejects dotted full Anthropic ids before runtime.

options.title: Route as hosted support
options.body: If usemolty.com owns the behavior outside OpenClaw, keep source changes out and close only after hosted proof shows the user can send a reply with the selected provider.

recommendation.title: Inspect hosted payload and state
recommendation.body: Have the hosted Molty owner capture the Brain & Keys save/session patch payload, stored workspace selection, and outgoing provider/model request, then repair deployment or migrate stale state if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: This crosses the Anthropic catalog and session model persistence work where this owner has the strongest recent merged history.
